Package dev.px.core.math

Class Stopwatch

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.math.Stopwatch
public final class Stopwatch extends Object
A monotonic elapsed-time check, for cooldowns and rate limits.

Replaces the old TimerUtil. Two differences matter. It uses System.nanoTime() rather than currentTimeMillis(), which can jump backwards when the system clock is adjusted and silently stall a cooldown. And elapsed(long) does not reset, so a check no longer has a side effect; tryConsume(long) is the combined form when that is what you actually want.
